description: Download a snapshot of the app's PocketBase data (data.db, auxiliary.db + WAL, storage/) as a .tar.gz file. Use when the user says: 'export my data', 'download my database', 'I want a backup of my app data', 'GDPR data portability', or similar. Returns the local file path the tarball was written to, plus its size in bytes. Rate-limited: 1 export per 24h on free plan, more on paid plans — 429 with code EXPORT_RATE_LIMITED if exceeded. Only works for apps with data.mode = 'pocketbase'. Returns NO_POCKETBASE error otherwise. If the app is sleeping (auto-sleep), wake it first by visiting its URL (auto-sleep wakes on first request), then retry.

app.description: App name or id. Defaults to the app in percher.toml.

out.description: Output file path. Defaults to ./<app>-pb-<timestamp>.tar.gz in the current directory.

name: percher_data_export
